title: after setup hook --scope user, doctor reports hooks-user ok and does not warn about the project's missing registration
source: intended: plan 2.4 doctor half (owner question 8): doctor reports the user-scope guard
intent: INTENDED behavior (plan 2.4). With the guard in `~/.claude/settings.json` and none in the project, `ok   hooks-user: jitso hook guard is registered on PreToolUse (Bash, orca MCP) and SessionEnd in ~/.claude/settings.json`, and the project line is `ok   hooks: not registered in this project; your own session is guarded by ...`, never a warn or a fail. A launched session carries its own guard, so the project registration is optional.

stdout.regex: (?m)^ok   hooks-user: jitso hook guard is registered on PreToolUse \(Bash, orca MCP\) and SessionEnd in ~/\.claude/settings\.json$
(?m)^ok   hooks: not registered in this project; your own session is guarded by jitso hook guard in ~/\.claude/settings\.json$
